# MathJax vendor files

`es5/tex-svg-full.js` and `es5/ui/safe.js` are unmodified MathJax browser components from npm package `mathjax@3.2.2`. The full component includes the TeX packages and SVG font data used by this editor; the Safe extension rejects unsafe TeX-provided URLs and styles. Both load locally without a CDN or a build step.
